content: {"phoneNote":"Hero photo is a pleasant mood picture but the first screen shows no address or phone, and the two underlined text links read as weak, near-identical actions.","desktopNote":"The overlapping dark card is a nice move, but the headline is cut at the fold and the hours section leaves the whole right half of the screen empty.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":3,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Desktop: shorten the hero card or lift it so headline and subtitle are visible above the fold; give the opening hours a two-column layout with map/address instead of a half-empty band.","Both: turn 'Poglejte degustacije' into a real filled button and add the place (Bizeljsko) and a phone number under the hero text so location and contact read in order.","Phone: tighten the huge gap between hero card and the '1897' block and shrink the oversized footer wordmark; desktop footer wordmark is also far too large."],"blockers":[]}
